key: Phew! Nice little storm we've got out there.
en: Phew! Nice little storm we've got out there.
ja: ふう! 外はなかなかの嵐だね。

key: I think I'll just stay here for a while.
en: I think I'll just stay here for a while.
ja: しばらくここにいようと思う。

key: You're welcome to stay and chat if you'd like, traveler.
en: You're welcome to stay and chat if you'd like, traveler.
ja: よければ、話し相手になってくれてもいいよ、旅の人。

key: I stay outside the city here, studying the various forms the Wasteland takes and the Pokémon that live around here.
en: I stay outside the city here, studying the various forms the Wasteland takes and the Pokémon that live around here.
ja: 私はこの街の外で、荒れ地の様々な姿と、そこに住むポケモンを研究しているんだ。

key: You haven't seen anything strange, have you?
en: You haven't seen anything strange, have you?
ja: 何か変わったもの、見なかったかい?

key: Oh, well, that was a silly question, everything is strange here.
en: Oh, well, that was a silly question, everything is strange here.
ja: ああ、いや、馬鹿な質問だったね。ここでは何もかもが変だ。

key: Perhaps it's strange that I ask about strange things in a place like this.
en: Perhaps it's strange that I ask about strange things in a place like this.
ja: こんな場所で「変なもの」を尋ねること自体が、変なのかもしれない。

key: That is, I'm looking for something in particular.
en: That is, I'm looking for something in particular.
ja: つまり、探しているものが特にあるんだ。

key: That is, I believe there's a Squirtle running around somewhere in the waste.
en: That is, I believe there's a Squirtle running around somewhere in the waste.
ja: というのも、この荒れ地のどこかにゼニガメがいるはずなんだ。

key: Now, I think you'll agree, this is no place for a Squirtle.
en: Now, I think you'll agree, this is no place for a Squirtle.
ja: ここがゼニガメのいるべき場所じゃないってことは、君も同意してくれると思う。

key: It belongs somewhere with fresh open water, but there's only muck here.
en: It belongs somewhere with fresh open water, but there's only muck here.
ja: 本来なら、きれいな水のある場所にいるべきなのに、ここにはヘドロしかない。

key: I want to find it to get it to safety, but so far I haven't been able to catch it.
en: I want to find it to get it to safety, but so far I haven't been able to catch it.
ja: 見つけて安全な場所に連れて行きたいんだけど、今のところ捕まえられていない。

key: If you see it anywhere, please do your best to catch it!
en: If you see it anywhere, please do your best to catch it!
ja: どこかで見かけたら、ぜひ捕まえてみてくれ!

key: Now that I think about it, maybe someone else around here has seen it.
en: Now that I think about it, maybe someone else around here has seen it.
ja: そういえば、この辺りの誰かが見てるかもしれないな。

key: Perhaps if you ask around you'll find some kind of lead.
en: Perhaps if you ask around you'll find some kind of lead.
ja: 聞き込みをすれば、何か手がかりが見つかるかもしれない。

key: Say, did you ever happen to find that Squirtle?
en: Say, did you ever happen to find that Squirtle?
ja: ところで、あのゼニガメ、見つけたりした?

key: I'd love to see the little fellow if you did.
en: I'd love to see the little fellow if you did.
ja: もし見つけたなら、ぜひその子を見てみたいな。

key: Just to check up on it, you know?
en: Just to check up on it, you know?
ja: ちょっと様子を確認したいだけなんだ。

key: Stranger, did you know there was supposed to be some kind of Squirtle around these parts?
en: Stranger, did you know there was supposed to be some kind of Squirtle around these parts?
ja: 旅の人、この辺りにゼニガメがいるらしいって、知ってたかい?

key: I was looking for it to make sure it would be okay and healthy, but I haven't found any sign of it...
en: I was looking for it to make sure it would be okay and healthy, but I haven't found any sign of it...
ja: 無事で健康かどうか確かめたくて探してたんだけど、痕跡ひとつ見つけられなくてね……

key: Ah, didn't you have it after all?
en: Ah, didn't you have it after all?
ja: ああ、実は持ってたのか!

key: Oh!
en: Oh!
ja: あ!

key: Is this really the same Squirtle?
en: Is this really the same Squirtle?
ja: これは本当に、あのゼニガメなのかい?

key: I suppose I wouldn't know.
en: I suppose I wouldn't know.
ja: まあ、私にはわからないだろうけど。

key: In any case, I had been concerned if the waste was affecting its health negatively, but...
en: In any case, I had been concerned if the waste was affecting its health negatively, but...
ja: とにかく、荒れ地の影響で体調を崩してないか心配だったんだけど……

key: As far as I can tell, this friend is as right as rain!
en: As far as I can tell, this friend is as right as rain!
ja: 見たところ、この子はぴんぴんしているみたいだ!

key: Maybe something about this muck is uniquely hospitable to Pokémon?
en: Maybe something about this muck is uniquely hospitable to Pokémon?
ja: もしかして、このヘドロには、ポケモンにとって独特の居心地の良さがあるのかもしれない。

key: As if inviting them to stay within its embrace...
en: As if inviting them to stay within its embrace...
ja: まるで、その腕の中に留まるよう誘っているみたいに……

key: For their protection, maybe?
en: For their protection, maybe?
ja: 守るため、なのかな?

key: Ah, nevermind me-- I'm just musing out loud at this point!
en: Ah, nevermind me-- I'm just musing out loud at this point!
ja: ああ、気にしないでくれ――ただの独り言だから!

key: Why don't you take this for your trouble, friend?
en: Why don't you take this for your trouble, friend?
ja: お礼に、これを受け取ってくれないか?

key: Perhaps it'll come in handy.
en: Perhaps it'll come in handy.
ja: 役に立つかもしれない。

key: Take care of your little friend now, won't you?
en: Take care of your little friend now, won't you?
ja: その小さな友達を、大事にしてあげてね。

key: Byxbysion was not always the wasteland you see now...
en: Byxbysion was not always the wasteland you see now...
ja: ビクスビシオンは、昔からこんな荒れ地だったわけじゃない……

key: But one day, in the blink of an eye, the piles of filth began to stack up.
en: But one day, in the blink of an eye, the piles of filth began to stack up.
ja: でもある日、あっという間に、汚泥の山が積み上がり始めた。

key: We never found their source, and they never stopped appearing...
en: We never found their source, and they never stopped appearing...
ja: その出所は誰にもわからず、汚泥は現れ続けた……

key: Once, the city mounted a huge effort to clear it all away- and we did.
en: Once, the city mounted a huge effort to clear it all away- and we did.
ja: かつて、街は総力を挙げてそれを取り除こうとして――実際にやり遂げた。

key: And in its place, we began constructing these old buildings, to expand the city.
en: And in its place, we began constructing these old buildings, to expand the city.
ja: そしてその跡地に、街を拡張するため、この古い建物群を建て始めたんだ。

key: So we worked.
en: So we worked.
ja: だから、私たちは働いた。

key: And then, as if overnight...
en: And then, as if overnight...
ja: それから、まるで一晩のうちに……

key: We woke to the same filth, returned-- no, doubled in mass-- from before we had cleared it.
en: We woke to the same filth, returned-- no, doubled in mass-- from before we had cleared it.
ja: 目覚めると、また同じ汚泥が戻っていた――いや、取り除く前より倍に増えていた。

key: It was then that we abandoned the waste. We built the large stone city walls, hoping to cage the corruption in... Dooming this barren land.
en: It was then that we abandoned the waste. We built the large stone city walls, hoping to cage the corruption in... Dooming this barren land.
ja: その時、私たちはこの荒れ地を見捨てたんだ。汚染を閉じ込めようと、大きな石の城壁を築いて……この不毛の地を、見捨てる形になった。

key: What more could there be to this curse, I wonder...
en: What more could there be to this curse, I wonder...
ja: この呪いには、まだ何かあるんだろうか……

key: There's a hidden network of tunnels underneath the waste... One, a vast grotto...
en: There's a hidden network of tunnels underneath the waste... One, a vast grotto...
ja: この荒れ地の下には、隠されたトンネルの網が広がっている……そのひとつは、広大な洞窟だ……

key: But even inside the grotto, there's one more secret tunnel...
en: But even inside the grotto, there's one more secret tunnel...
ja: でも、その洞窟の中にも、さらにもうひとつ、秘密の通路がある……

key: Like some kind of twisted tunnel-ception...
en: Like some kind of twisted tunnel-ception...
ja: まるで、ねじれたトンネルの中のトンネル、みたいなものだ……
